proyectos.descripcion: Developed a comprehensive desktop software solution for inventory, sales, and administration management, featuring an analytics dashboard for a board game retail store. Strictly separated responsibilities using a 4-Tier Architecture, ensuring code maintainability. Optimized SQL database queries. Project managed under agile methodologies (SCRUM) with exhaustive backlog maintenance.

Full-Stack e-commerce platform developed for selling custom products. Implemented a secure backend with CodeIgniter 4 for catalog and user session management, seamlessly interfaced with a dynamic and interactive frontend.

Designed and developed an immersive 3D web portfolio. Merged software engineering knowledge with Technical Art to create an interactive browser environment. Strong focus on technical performance: auditing Lighthouse metrics, managing graphic assets, and seamlessly integrating React components with the WebGL ecosystem. Optimized using Draco compression, baked Texture Atlases, and global state management. Features mathematical camera interpolation and dynamic 2D accessibility.

Technical and artistic development of custom 3D models (Fiverr). Extensive experience in the complete pipeline: high and low poly modeling, normal baking, PBR texturing, and creating deformable skeletons (Rigging/Weight Painting) ready for implementation in engines like Unity.

Final Degree Project (Engineering Thesis). Distributed educational gamification ecosystem using a decoupled microservices architecture with generative AI quest creation under a strict HITL (Human-in-the-Loop) paradigm: AI generates structured encounters with confidence scores while educators validate and adjust via live simulation. High-performance .NET 9 WebAPI implementing CQRS (MediatR) and relational Event Sourcing over PostgreSQL 17 with secure HttpOnly JWT cookies. Python/FastAPI microservice integrating the official Google Gemini SDK. Interactive React 18 frontend featuring a 'Painterly RPG' aesthetic, tactical multi-phase boss fights, interactive historical timelines, real-time classroom leaderboards, and an academic achievement cosmetic bazaar.

Design and implementation of a low-level client-server network communication system built directly with native OS sockets, avoiding high-level frameworks. In-depth comparative analysis between connection-oriented stream reliability (TCP) and stateless low-latency datagram broadcasting (UDP). Features a multi-threaded server architecture with thread-safe client synchronization (threading.Lock), connection lifecycle management, graceful handling of unexpected client disconnections, socket reuse (SO_REUSEADDR), and a desktop inspection client with real-time packet telemetry and logging.

proyectos.titulo: Scientific Computing & Numerical Analysis Engine (Algebra & ODEs)
proyectos.descripcion: Development of a computational mathematics and numerical analysis engine focused on solving continuous mathematical models. Features non-linear root finding (Newton-Raphson, Fixed-Point), linear system solving via Gaussian Elimination with partial pivoting, finite difference polynomial interpolation (Newton-Gregory), numerical quadrature (Trapezoidal, Simpson 1/3 and 3/8), and Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE) solving via 4th-order Runge-Kutta (RK4) and predictor-corrector methods. Serves as foundational mathematical rigor directly applicable to physics simulations, shaders, and 3D Technical Art.

capitulos.titulo: Roots in Engineering & Robotics: Forging Rigorous Logic
capitulos.narrativa: My technical journey began with analog circuits, pneumatic control, and C programming for microcontrollers. Founding the Robotics Club taught me fault tolerance, methodical diagnostics, and that software always operates within real-world constraints.
capitulos.problema_resuelto: Designed and deployed automated test benches and robotic prototypes with zero tolerance for wiring errors.
capitulos.quote_persona5: A system's resilience is forged before writing the first line of code.

capitulos.rol: B.S. in Information Systems (2026 Graduate) // APU // Teaching Assistant
capitulos.narrativa: At FaCENA-UNNE, I formalized my mastery of algorithmic complexity, data structures, and design patterns. As a Teaching Assistant for Algorithms I and Software Engineering 1, I mentored hundreds of students, translating abstract concepts into clean architectures.
capitulos.problema_resuelto: Reduced failure rates in foundational courses via practical algorithmic decomposition guides and live debugging sessions.
capitulos.quote_persona5: You do not truly master a data structure until you can explain it with crystal clarity.
capitulos.metrica_desc: Students mentored in Algorithms & Software Patterns

capitulos.titulo: The Game Master Factor: System Psychology, Incentives & UX
capitulos.narrativa: Running tabletop RPGs for years is a live product engineering laboratory. A Game Master manages concurrent rules, balances resource economies under uncertainty, and maintains engagement without cognitive overload. I translated these mechanics into enterprise software: every user flow must be clear, predictable, and rewarding.
capitulos.problema_resuelto: Eliminated cognitive friction in enterprise management tools via immediate tactile feedback and intuitive hierarchy.
capitulos.quote_persona5: If a user makes an error, the fault lies with the system's architecture of incentives.
capitulos.metrica_desc: Reduction in onboarding time on complex software systems

capitulos.titulo: B2B Architecture, Event Sourcing & Applied AI
capitulos.rol: Software Architect & Systems Engineer // Applied AI
capitulos.narrativa: Today, all disciplines converge: I spearheaded OcioStore in .NET/C# under a strict 4-Tier architecture for bulk retail management, joined UNNE's Software Quality Research Group, and completed my degree defending my Final Thesis: an educational gamification ecosystem powered by generative AI with CQRS and Event Sourcing.
capitulos.problema_resuelto: Replaced error-prone manual workflows with transactional architectures and AI agent process automation.
capitulos.quote_persona5: Artificial Intelligence does not replace engineering: it demands that architecture be twice as rigorous.
capitulos.metrica_desc: Guaranteed precision and consistency across inference pipelines
